sources_used: Federal Reserve H.10 exchange rates, 2025-06-30 release
Yahoo Finance yfinance market snapshot supplied in config/input.json

analysis_model.reason: STRATTEC is a single-segment automotive component manufacturer with ordinary receivables, inventory, production equipment and operating liabilities. Cash and credit-facility borrowing are separable financing items, so the ordinary owner-earnback model applies.

assets.explanation: Cash and equivalents; USD79.8m of USD84.6m was domestic and excess cash was in overnight money-market funds. Apply a 70% haircut for working capital, cyclicality and execution needs.
OEM receivables; GM and Ford were 46% of receivables, so this is operating capital rather than detachable cash.
Finished goods, work in process and materials needed for vehicle programs; the USD16.9m inventory decline boosted FY2025 cash flow.
Net factories and production machinery in Wisconsin and Mexico required for casting, stamping, plating, molding, electronics and assembly.
Pre-production costs, tax recoverables, deferred-tax and other assets; mostly program- or tax-linked and not detachable cash.

liabilities.explanation: Supplier payables; the USD10.7m increase boosted FY2025 operating cash flow and is not permanent financing.
Payroll, VAT, income tax, warranty and other current operating obligations.
Credit-facility borrowing, deducted at 100% from detachable cash.
Post-employment benefits and other noncurrent liabilities, which constrain future distributable cash.

owner_earnback.interpretation: At the supplied CNY2.478bn market cap, 70% of cash less 100% of debt leaves CNY367m discounted detachable net cash. Sustainable cash profit uses FY2025 parent income plus depreciation less the USD13m FY2026 capex guide, then a 20% prudence haircut for customer concentration, auto cyclicality and margin-recovery uncertainty. It is about CNY117m, implying an operating-business price of CNY2.111bn and about 18.0 years of owner earnback. Reported FY2025 FCF is not extrapolated because working-capital release made it unusually high.

cash_breakdown.reason: Mostly domestic money-market cash, while manufacturing still requires liquidity.

profit_adjustments.reason: Management USD13m FY2026 capex guidance, not unusually low FY2025 spend.
20% haircut after normalization for cycle, concentration and margin uncertainty.

dividend.forecast_basis: No common cash dividend appears in the FY2024 or FY2025 equity/cash-flow statements and no recurring dividend was announced; forecast is zero rather than assuming a new policy.

business.one_line: 为全球整车厂设计并制造汽车门锁、门把手、钥匙/锁芯、电子控制和电动开启系统，利润来自车型项目量产后的零部件销售与制造效率。
business.main_business: 单一汽车零部件制造分部，产品包括电动开启方案、门把手与外饰、钥匙与锁具、锁扣、用户界面控制及售后服务件，覆盖90多款燃油、混动和电动车型。
business.profit_source: FY2025门把手与外饰占收入25%、电动开启24%、钥匙与锁具18%、锁扣13%。利润改善主要来自销量、美元走强、固定成本利用率、定价和重组。
business.business_model: 与整车厂共同设计车型专用部件，先承担工程和专用设备投入，再随车型量产按件销售；美国和墨西哥自有工厂完成压铸、冲压、电镀、注塑、电子制造和总装，依赖客户定点、车型产量及营运资本周转。
business.industry_position: 公司具有逾百年汽车进入与安全领域经验和广泛车型覆盖，但规模小且客户议价权强。GM、Ford、Stellantis合计贡献64%收入，属于北美头部整车厂的重要专业供应商，而非拥有终端定价权的品牌商。

risks.explanation: GM、Ford、Stellantis合计占收入64%；车型取消、减产或压价会影响收入、毛利并可能造成专用设备减值。
FY2025经营现金流USD71.7m受到库存和其他资产下降、应付增加的显著抬升，USD64.5m自由现金流不可直接外推。
毛利率由12.2%升至15.0%，受汇率、定价、重组和产能利用率共同推动，环境逆转时可能回吐。
车型项目需要专用设备；FY2025墨西哥人工成本增加USD6.2m，FY2026资本开支指引也高于当年实际值。

evidence.claim: FY2025 revenue USD565.066m, gross profit USD84.577m, parent net income USD18.685m, assets USD391.454m and liabilities USD145.023m.
FY2025 operating cash flow USD71.677m and capex USD7.156m; working-capital changes materially boosted cash.
GM, Ford and Stellantis were 29%, 23% and 12% of FY2025 sales.
USD amounts translated at 7.1721 CNY/USD, the H.10 rate on 2025-06-27.
CNY2.478bn market cap dated 2026-08-03 and PE TTM 14.503301 are supplied Yahoo Finance yfinance inputs.

limitations: Research period is 2025-12-31, while the latest annual filing then available covers FY ended 2025-06-29.
Statements use 7.1721 CNY/USD at fiscal year-end; supplied CNY market cap is dated 2026-08-03.
Sustainable cash-profit and detachable-cash haircuts are research judgments, not company guidance.
